mentions.name: WingWeave
mentions.description: This is a browser-based flight game built with vanilla Three.js and Tone.js. It runs on a plain requestAnimationFrame loop with no game engine or physics library, and is set to chill music. It features an online leaderboard, which has already required sanitizing racial slurs from player entries.
mentions.source_excerpt:
A browser flight game with vanilla Three.js and Tone.js: https://www.wingweave.org/

There's no engine, no physics lib, just a requestAnimationFrame loop and chill music.

The dev highlight so far has been 30 players in the first 48 hours and already having to sanitize racial slurs from the leaderboard smh.
